notes.title: v1.2.1 hotfix
notes.content:
Just released a hotfix for patch v1.2 because achievements were broken. Also, sadly, the mouse cursor bug had to be reverted in order to make the achievements work again.

I won't go too into detail but it's due to the Steamworks plugin for the game engine (construct 2) is not compatible with the most recent version of the underlying technology (nw.js). So I had to revert my game back to an older version of nw.js.

When the Steamworks plugin for Construct 2 gets updated I will release a new update to fix the mouse cursor bug.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the achievements not registering with Steam
[*]Reverted the mouse cursor bug (mouse cursor will still get messed up in windowed mode)
[/list]

I sincerely apologize if this caused you to miss an achievement.

notes.title: New update v1.2 - Minor visual fixes
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
This update has a few minor bug fixes in it. They are all visual fixes so there's nothing that effects gameplay.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[b]Visual fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue for first time players where the glowing rectangle on the upgrade screen was off center by about 18 pixels
[*]Fixed an issue in the UI where the build / tool buttons would become too dark if you didn't have enough money to buy it, so I lightened it up so you can still see the icon
[*]Fixed an issue when playing in windowed mode where the mouse cursor would change into a standard Windows cursor rather than the game's custom cursor
[/list]

notes.title: Balance patch v1.1 now live
notes.content:
[h1]Official patch notes - v1.1[/h1]

[b]Medium Difficulty[/b]
[list]
[*]Change Castle max health from 25 to 15
[*]Increase the health of all enemies by 15%
[*]Increase the starting minerals from 60 to 70
[/list]

[b]Hard Difficulty[/b]
[list]
[*]Change Castle max health from 20 to 7
[*]Increase the health of all enemies by 15%
[*]Increase the starting minerals from 70 to 80
[/list]

[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*]Wave 14 boss - Decrease the damage it does to the Castle if leaked from 12 to 8
[/list]

[b]Tools[/b]
[list]
[*]Repair - Change the amount repaired from 3 to 2
[*]Repair - Change the cooldown time from 10 to 14 seconds
[*]Stasis - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 40 to 50 crowns
[*]Explosive - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 160 to 220 crowns
[/list]

[b]Defenses[/b]
[list]
[*]Surge - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 30 to 50 crowns
[*]Drill - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 80 to 120 crowns
[*]Bomber- Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 160 to 200 crowns
[/list]

[b]Blessings[/b]
[list]
[*]Efficient Tools - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 60 to 70 crowns
[*]Efficient Building - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 30 to 40 crowns
[*]Surge Shock - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 400 to 440 crowns
[*]Salvage Parts - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 520 to 560 crowns
[*]Massive Burst - Increase the cost to unlock (crowns) from 800 to 900 crowns
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]When recycling the Mining Drill, the floating text displayed the wrong number of minerals returned
[/list]

notes.title: Balance update (v1.1) coming soon
notes.content:
Many players have expressed that Whitevale Defender is too easy. So in the coming week I will be working on a patch to increase the difficulty. Below is a list of my proposed changes. [b]Feedback is welcome[/b].

[b]General[/b]
I want to keep the easy difficulty mostly unchanged for those people who are a bit slower and not strategy experts. For medium I want to increase the difficulty slightly. Then hard is where I want the largest changes to difficulty to occur. I always meant hard difficulty to be for the more hardcore tower defense players, but it seems I have missed the mark. I also want to adjust some of the crown costs to the unlockables to spread them out more. I definitely want to avoid having to grind to achieve the unlocks, but hopefully spreading them out a little will give the overall game a better pacing.

[h1]Proposed Changes - To be implemented later this week[/h1]

[b]Medium Difficulty[/b]
[list]
[*]Change Castle max health from 25 to 15
